how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackrock-spire-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4788:obj:0: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to ⟦E1⟧ in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:4788:details:0: While I look over the third and fourth tablets of Mosh'aru, you must find the fifth and sixth! It will not be easy, for they are held by the Smolderthorn trolls within ⟦E3⟧. The spire is a dark mountain of fire between the ⟦E4⟧ and the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:4788:details:1: Good luck, ⟦1⟧. ⟦E3⟧ is no place for decent folk...
rows.quest:4788:progress:0: Have you been to the spire, ⟦2⟧? Do you have the fifth and sixth tables?
rows.quest:4788:completion:0: Unbelievable! You found them! You truly are a hero, ⟦3⟧!
rows.quest:4788:completion:1: That's a good thing, because I've been reading the tablets you brought me before, and from what I gathered... we're going to need a hero to stop what's coming...
rows.quest:4701:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: ⟦E7⟧. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.
rows.quest:4701:details:0: You have no doubt seen the worgs which the Blackrock orcs command.
rows.quest:4701:details:1: It is curious - no matter how many we destroy, their numbers never dwindle. My scouts have reported that the worgs are bred, trained, and ultimately exported from ⟦E3⟧: capital city of the Blackrock orcs. You must travel to ⟦E3⟧ and discover the source of this menace. Discover... and destroy.
rows.quest:4701:details:2: Good luck, ⟦4⟧. May Cenarius protect you...⟦5⟧
rows.quest:4701:progress:0: Have you discovered and dealt with the source of the worg menace?
rows.quest:4701:completion:0: Do not dwell upon her suffering, ⟦6⟧. The beast was corrupt - a product of dark magic. You have done the ⟦E9⟧ a great service and you shall be rewarded.
rows.quest:4724:obj:0: Slay ⟦E7⟧, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.
rows.quest:4724:details:0: Some say the worg controlled by the Blackrock orcs are the creation of a supernatural force. Others say they are not true worg but instead a breed of demon dog, granted to the orcs by a fallen pit lord.
rows.quest:4724:details:1: The truth is far less contrived but every bit as frightening. The worg of Blackrock come from ⟦E7⟧ and her mate. ⟦E7⟧ is the gigantic den mother of the worg. Her mate? Nobody has ever lived to tell the tale of that one.
rows.quest:4724:details:2: Strike at the heart of the worg. Destroy ⟦E7⟧... and ⟦7⟧, watch your back.
rows.quest:4724:progress:0: With the pack mistress slain, we can begin to thin out the worg sentries of the Spire and eventually make some headway into the city.
rows.quest:4724:completion:0: Rabid pups? Gizrul the Slavener? And you live to tell the tale?! Incredible! A tribute well earned!
rows.quest:4729:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a ⟦E13⟧ to ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:4729:details:0: You're probably wondering what I'm doing out here. Look at the cages! Ain't it obvious?
rows.quest:4729:details:1: I'm an animal lover, first and foremost, but a salesman by trade. I track down exotic animals for the rich and famous and domesticate the beasts so they behave as proper pets.
rows.quest:4729:details:2: Now you're probably wondering, "What can I do for you, ⟦E14⟧." The answer is simple: Take this here beast cage and find me some worg pups. For that, I'll domesticate a worg for you!⟦8⟧
rows.quest:4729:progress:0: <⟦E14⟧ is busy arguing with Toucan Stan.>
rows.quest:4729:completion:0: You got 'em at the perfect time, ⟦9⟧. Any later and they'd be untrainable! Gimmie a minute and I'll have the little fella ready for you to take home.
rows.quest:4862:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:4862:obj:1: By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.⟦10⟧
rows.quest:4862:details:0: Believe it or not, there are people out there willing to pay for the most vile of domesticated beast!
rows.quest:4862:details:1: I'd sent ⟦E15⟧ into the Spire to try and collect some of those spire spider eggs but I haven't heard from her in weeks. Maybe you can help me out?
rows.quest:4862:details:2: I'll tell you what, ⟦11⟧. Go to ⟦E3⟧ and collect some spire spider eggs for me. Bring them back here and not only will I give you a little cash, but I'll even domesticate one for you!
rows.quest:4862:progress:0: Are those spider eggs in your pack or are you just happy to see me?
rows.quest:4862:completion:0: What a load! I mean, look at all those eggs! These should bring in a right few gold.
rows.quest:4862:completion:1: As promised, here's your own little critter. Don't get bitten!
rows.quest:4981:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and find out what happened to ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:4981:details:0: Never trust a goblin. That's what it comes down to, ⟦12⟧.
rows.quest:4981:details:1: ⟦E15⟧ is her name - one of our slipperiest operatives. I found out she was working for some shady exotic pet dealer out of the ⟦E4⟧ named ⟦E14⟧, in essence, two timing us. Worse yet, she was using ⟦E17⟧ funds to finance her operations.
rows.quest:4981:details:2: I want her brought back here alive.
rows.quest:4981:details:3: She was last seen entering ⟦E3⟧. Find her and bring her back.
rows.quest:4981:details:4: And ⟦13⟧, do not let her sweet talk you.
rows.quest:4981:completion:0: I won't lie to you, ⟦14⟧. I needed the money! ⟦E14⟧ pays very, very well - much better than the K.E.F. ever could.
rows.quest:4981:completion:1: But don't doubt my loyalties! Why do you think I'm down here? To get that crazy goblin some exotic animal eggs or something equally inane? No, only someone truly daft would come to ⟦E3⟧ to collect pets. Yep, I don't reckon too many people like that exist in this world.
rows.quest:4981:completion:3: The last thing we need are those kinds of people breeding.
rows.quest:4982:obj:0: Find ⟦E18⟧ and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.⟦15⟧
rows.quest:4982:details:0: At night when this place is lightly guarded, I sneak around the city, taking notes and writing down anything I see that could be of some strategic value to the K.E.F.
rows.quest:4982:details:1: Last night, however, things went dreadfully wrong. I stumbled across a tripwire and set off an alarm. I stashed my recon gear and ran for cover! Unfortunately, I can't get back to that gear. They've doubled and tripled up the patrols! All that information is lost.
rows.quest:4982:details:2: Get my belongings back and I'll return to the K.E.F. peacefully.
rows.quest:4982:completion:0: You've done it! Once ⟦E19⟧ has these plans, he'll forget all about the nasty things he wanted to do to me.
rows.quest:4983:obj:0: Take ⟦E20⟧ back to Grandmaster ⟦E19⟧ in Kargath.⟦17⟧
rows.quest:4983:details:0: Take this report back to ⟦E19⟧. It will redeem my good name and will surely give the K.E.F. a strategic advantage in dealing with these orcs.
rows.quest:4983:details:1: Come with you? I've got way too much work to do. Get going, they need these reports as soon as possible!⟦18⟧
rows.quest:4983:completion:0: I've got to hand it to her; she's managed to weasel her way out of another sticky situation! These reports will prove to be invaluable in our dealings with the Blackrock orcs.
rows.quest:4983:completion:1: Of course, you will be rewarded for your hard work.
rows.quest:5001:obj:0: Find ⟦E18⟧ and return them to her. Good luck!⟦19⟧
rows.quest:5001:details:0: Ordinarily I don't deal with ⟦20⟧s but it seems that I'm stuck between a troll and a hard place. You see, my mission here is one of utmost importance to the ⟦E17⟧. The information I've discovered, however, applies to the well being of the ⟦E9⟧ as well. Now believe me, I'm no ⟦E9⟧ sympathizer, but the Blackrock threat is bigger than just a bunch of orcs.
rows.quest:5001:details:1: You help me out by finding my belongings and I'll help you out with some information that could prove useful to your kind.
rows.quest:5001:completion:0: Well I'll be! Where were they??
rows.quest:5002:details:0: I'm a goblin of my word, ⟦21⟧. Now listen closely:
rows.quest:5002:details:1: These orcs are used primarily as beasts of burden and cannon fodder for the black dragonflight!
rows.quest:5002:details:2: Their true leader is none other than ⟦E24⟧, brood of ⟦E25⟧. I've also discovered the location of ⟦E24⟧'s subordinates in this part of the citadel.
rows.quest:5002:details:3: Take this map to ⟦E23⟧ in the ⟦E4⟧. It has the location of these fiends marked for easy identification.
rows.quest:5002:progress:0: Ah, ⟦22⟧. It has been a long time.
rows.quest:5002:completion:0: This coincides with much of what we already knew. Regardless, it is interesting and rather unfortunate information.
rows.quest:5002:completion:1: The markings on this map will prove valuable in thinning the Blackrock menace.
rows.quest:4734:obj:0: Use the ⟦E26⟧ on an egg in the Rookery.
rows.quest:4734:details:0: ⟦23⟧, I've been working hard on a new device, the eggscilloscope! It's designed to project a burst of cold energy at the egg of a black dragon... and freeze it solid! Can you test it for me?
rows.quest:4734:details:1: I heard that high up in ⟦E3⟧, the dragons have a rookery where they hatch their eggs. That's where you'll have to go to test the eggscilloscope, and then let me know how it worked!
rows.quest:4734:details:2: And don't worry. Frozen dragon eggs should be harmless. It's the unfrozen ones you have to worry about!
rows.quest:4734:completion:0: It worked? Splendid! I knew it would!
rows.quest:4734:completion:1: While you were gone I was working on a new version of the eggscilloscope. This one has a much longer range.
rows.quest:4734:completion:2: Here, you can have one in case you go back to ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4735:obj:0: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the ⟦E27⟧ to ⟦E28⟧ at Flame Crest in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4735:details:0: ⟦25⟧, I'm finally ready for real samples of dragon eggs! Here, take this collectronic module. It's designed to extract a dragon egg and prepare it for transport. Go back to the Rookery and use the module to collect eggs.
rows.quest:4735:details:1: And don't forget to freeze them first, or they might hatch before you can collect them!
rows.quest:4735:details:2: When you have enough eggs, bring them to me!
rows.quest:4735:progress:0: Do you have the eggs, ⟦26⟧?  My patron heard you were collecting them for me, and is very eager to get his hands on them!
rows.quest:4735:completion:0: Wow, you got them! The collectronic module worked! I'm a genius!
rows.quest:4735:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦27⟧. My patron will be very pleased to get these eggs...
rows.quest:4742:obj:0: Find the three gemstones of command: The ⟦E29⟧, ⟦E30⟧, and ⟦E31⟧. Return them, along with the ⟦E32⟧, to ⟦E33⟧.
rows.quest:4742:obj:1: The Generals, as told to you by ⟦E33⟧, are: ⟦E34⟧ of the Smolderthorn; ⟦E35⟧ of the Spirestone; and ⟦E36⟧ of the Bloodaxe.
rows.quest:4742:details:0: As you can see, the unadorned seal has three empty sockets. Each of those sockets must be filled with a gemstone representing the leadership's command. Finally, ⟦E36⟧, master of the lower citadel, must forge the seal in the flames of the Black Dragonflight.
rows.quest:4742:details:1: Understand this, mortal: the chance that one of the three generals of the lower citadel would carry a gemstone at any given time is rare. You must be vigilant in your quest. Remain determined!
rows.quest:4742:progress:0: Courage and patience above all else, ⟦28⟧!
rows.quest:4742:completion:1: B<The pieces that you had collected have disappeared.>
rows.quest:4742:completion:2: The ⟦E39⟧ is now ready. It is time for the final step.
rows.quest:4743:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to the Wyrmbog in ⟦E40⟧. Find the ancient drake, ⟦E41⟧ and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.
rows.quest:4743:obj:1: It is at that moment which you must place the ⟦E39⟧ before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the ⟦E42⟧ on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the ⟦E39⟧!
rows.quest:4743:details:0: Few of the black dragonkin, outside of those in the upper citadel, have the ability to forge the seal with their own flaming breath. Wyrmthalak is one such dragonkin, but his will is unbreakable.
rows.quest:4743:details:1: You must travel to the Wyrmbog in ⟦E40⟧. It is there that you will find an ancient drake known as ⟦E41⟧. You must break his will, ⟦29⟧. Break it and use this orb on his weakened form. You will have scant seconds to control his mind and fan the flames that will forge the seal.
rows.quest:4743:progress:0: Waste no time, ⟦30⟧. ⟦E24⟧ works feverishly to unleash his evil upon our world.
rows.quest:4743:completion:0: Stand steady while I cast the final invocation of protection.
rows.quest:4743:completion:1: B<⟦E33⟧'s eyes turn to twin orbs of flame.>
rows.quest:4743:completion:3: Know this, I have imbued the artifact with some powerful protective wards. In your darkest hour, when all appears to be lost, the might of the red flight will be at your disposal.
rows.quest:4764:details:0: There is a chamber, high in ⟦E3⟧, that was once called the Hall of Fortune. It was where the Dark Iron dwarves kept their relics, trophies and objects of art.
rows.quest:4764:details:1: That was long ago. It is said the hall has collapsed and is now used for... less savory tasks. But I believe some old dwarven relics may still be found there.
rows.quest:4764:details:2: One such relic is Doomrigger's clasp, with a surface so encrusted with rare gems that it was said to make weep any dwarf who gazes upon it.
rows.quest:4764:progress:0: Do you have the clasp, ⟦32⟧? My patron will pay very handsomely for it.
rows.quest:4764:completion:0: You found it! So the rumors were true!
rows.quest:4764:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦33⟧. My patron, ⟦E49⟧, will be quite pleased to see this addition to this collection.
rows.quest:4765:details:0: I have packaged Doomriggers Clasp into a crate, suitable for shipment to ⟦E51⟧. ⟦34⟧, you have been extremely helpful -- can I ask you for one last favor?
rows.quest:4765:details:1: Deliver the crate to ⟦E49⟧. You will find him in the Keep of ⟦E51⟧. I am sure he'll be very pleased to see what you have for him.
rows.quest:4765:progress:0: I was told a messenger would come. One with a gift from ⟦E3⟧.⟦35⟧⟦36⟧Are you he?
rows.quest:4765:completion:0: Ah, so you are he! You have my thanks, ⟦37⟧. And... if you didn't already know... the gratitude of a noble in the house of Ridgewell is nigh worth a king's ransom.
rows.quest:4766:details:0: An agent of mine, ⟦E48⟧, was sent to the ⟦E4⟧ to scout the ruined city of Thaurissan. That destroyed city of the Dark Iron dwarves may hide objects of great value... objects that would fit nicely into our family museum.
rows.quest:4766:details:1: Mayara says she found something and will need aid in retrieving it, but it is not in Thaurissan. Instead, a foray into ⟦E3⟧ will be required.
rows.quest:4766:details:2: I do not know the details, but if interested then speak with Mayara in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4766:completion:0: You came from ⟦E51⟧? Wonderful -- I know of an object of art that Remington would kill to have in his museum, but extracting it won't be easy.
rows.quest:4768:details:0: ⟦E56⟧ holds the writings of the long-dead dwarf Urheld Darkstone. An alchemist of great skill, he was thought insane by his contemporaries and, hence, did not share his research.
rows.quest:4768:details:1: But he did etch it onto tablets, and I believe one such tablet lies in ⟦E3⟧, in a chamber once named the Hall of Fortune. I know not what it is now called, for few enter Blackrock and return.
rows.quest:4768:details:2: But if you are willing to brave its dangers and return to me with the tablet, your reward will be great.
rows.quest:4768:progress:0: Have you found the Tablet, ⟦38⟧?  I yearn to delve into its secrets.
rows.quest:4768:completion:0: Excellent. The formulae etched into this tablet will consume days of research, but I am confident such research will bear sweet fruit.
rows.quest:4768:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦39⟧. You have been invaluable to us.
rows.quest:4769:details:0: ⟦E55⟧ sent me word from Kargath, in the ⟦E58⟧. Through her studies, she believes there is an ancient text within ⟦E3⟧ that would benefit our research. To confirm this, she will need someone to extract the text from the spire. No easy task.
rows.quest:4769:details:1: If interested, then speak with Vivian in Kargath.
rows.quest:4769:completion:0: It is true. I believe there is a tablet held within ⟦E3⟧, a tablet that contains old alchemical recipes. I am glad you are here, for I need help in retrieving the tablet.
rows.quest:4769:completion:1: Make yourself comfortable, and I will explain further.
rows.quest:4866:obj:0: In the heart of ⟦E3⟧ you will find ⟦E59⟧. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to ⟦E60⟧ when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.
rows.quest:4866:details:0: It's probably one of the most potent poisons in the world, ⟦40⟧!
rows.quest:4866:details:1: I've overheard the Blackrock speaking about its lethality in my jaunts into the Spire. They call it 'Mother's Milk', named after ⟦E59⟧, the big nasty spider in the Skitterweb cave.
rows.quest:4866:details:2: Now here's what I need from you: A live sample of the Milk, flowing through YOUR veins. Just bringing me the gland won't be enough! Get her to poison you and come back to me!
rows.quest:4866:details:3: Then... I get to milk ya!
rows.quest:4866:details:4: B<Rubs his hands together in anticipation.>
rows.quest:4866:completion:0: This is gonna make the best ale yet!
rows.quest:4866:completion:1: Eh, what did you think I was gonna use this for? Poison or something??
rows.quest:4867:details:1: Take this note! Get me my mojo!
rows.quest:4867:progress:0: Ah! Do you have my mojo?
rows.quest:4867:completion:0: Aha! I can already feel my powers returning to me. And my mind is no longer wracked by Urok's curse.
rows.quest:4867:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦41⟧! Humility is below me, but I must acknowledge your aid.
rows.quest:4867:completion:2: And I bid you fortune in your journeys through ⟦E3⟧. You are a fool to think you could make your way to the top, but your bravery is without question.
rows.quest:4903:obj:0: Slay ⟦E35⟧, ⟦E34⟧, and ⟦E36⟧. Recover ⟦E66⟧. Return to ⟦E67⟧ in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
rows.quest:4903:details:0: By order of ⟦E67⟧, the following inhabitants of ⟦E3⟧ must be destroyed:
rows.quest:4903:details:4: You will also be required to return any important documents that you may find.
rows.quest:4903:completion:0: <⟦E67⟧'s dull green skin turns a pasty white for a brief moment.>
rows.quest:4907:details:0: Hi, ⟦42⟧. Remember ⟦E28⟧? Well, she remembers you! She sent me a message to keep an eye out for you, because... she needs your help again. I think it has something to do with her studies on dragons.
rows.quest:4907:details:1: You should speak to her in the ⟦E4⟧, at the Flame Crest.
rows.quest:4907:completion:0: Felnok was right! I do need your help again, and this time... it's going to be really dangerous.
rows.quest:4974:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and slay Warchief ⟦E69⟧ ⟦E70⟧. Take his head and return to ⟦E71⟧.
rows.quest:4974:details:0: ⟦E69⟧ dares make such grand claims because of the protection he is afforded by the black flight.
rows.quest:4974:details:1: You, ⟦43⟧, will find a way to pass through the Halls of Ascension. You will then find 'Warchief' ⟦E69⟧ ⟦E70⟧ and you will destroy him - FOR THE HORDE!
rows.quest:4974:details:2: B<⟦E72⟧ slams a fist down upon his throne.>
rows.quest:4974:details:3: The next time you return to my chambers, you will hold his head high in triumph and then you shall present it to your Warchief. Do this and be honored as a hero of the ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:4974:completion:0: You have dealt a crippling blow to the forces of Blackrock, ⟦44⟧. With their Warchief slain, the Blackrock legion is once again thrown into the maw of chaos.
rows.quest:4974:completion:1: In honor of your heroics, the people of ⟦E73⟧ shall be rewarded!
rows.quest:5047:details:0: You'll find ⟦E74⟧ in ⟦E75⟧, ⟦45⟧. Tell him that 'Finkle is A-OK' and that the suit works perfectly.
rows.quest:5047:details:2: B<Finkle hands you a glowing piece of flesh.>
rows.quest:5047:details:3: I snatched it from the beast's innards during my 'vacation.'
rows.quest:5047:details:4: I bet Malyfous could give you a fairly accurate assessment of what he can do with parts from a monster like this!
rows.quest:5047:details:5: Oh, I suppose you don't know where ⟦E75⟧ is, do you? To ⟦E76⟧, ⟦46⟧!
rows.quest:5047:completion:0: Alive? Suit worked? And what do we have here?
rows.quest:5081:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and destroy ⟦E34⟧, ⟦E35⟧, and ⟦E36⟧. Return to ⟦E23⟧ when the job is done.
rows.quest:5081:details:0: This information fills in the gaps to our otherwise impeccable intelligence of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5081:details:2: First their war master, the troll ⟦E77⟧, must be destroyed. Without his battle plans, the Blackrock orcs will be thrown into chaos.
rows.quest:5081:details:3: You must then take out the ogre Highlord, ⟦E79⟧. The cowardly ogres of Blackrock are powerless without his leadership.
rows.quest:5081:details:4: Lastly, the overlord of the citadel: Wyrmthalak. With Wyrmthalak dead, their central command unit is without a conduit.
rows.quest:5081:completion:0: Excellent work, ⟦48⟧. At the very least, you have bought us more time - precious, precious time.
rows.quest:5089:details:0: From the corpse of the defeated serpent you uncover what appears to be a note of some importance: A letter from his superior, ⟦E81⟧, concerning protocol.
rows.quest:5089:details:1: Your instinct tells you that you should take it to ⟦E23⟧.
rows.quest:5102:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and destroy ⟦E81⟧. Return to ⟦E23⟧ when the job is done.⟦50⟧
rows.quest:5102:details:0: We battle against these beasts on two fronts: From our capital of ⟦E51⟧ we fight them from the inside out and here, in the ⟦E4⟧, we take the battle to their doorstep. We must be vigilant, ⟦51⟧. None should be spared our wrath as none of our own were spared when they struck at our homes and families.
rows.quest:5102:details:2: The task certainly will not be a simple one, but the rewards shall be extravagant.
rows.quest:5102:completion:0: Surely, we will strike against their dragon lords next. Well done, brave soldier of the ⟦E9⟧! Well done, indeed.
rows.quest:5127:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and find ⟦E83⟧. Slay him and then use the ⟦E84⟧ upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
rows.quest:5127:obj:2: Return both the ⟦E86⟧ and the ⟦E85⟧ to ⟦E87⟧ in ⟦E76⟧.
rows.quest:5127:details:0: ⟦E87⟧ makes deals, he does not accept them from insignificant mortals.
rows.quest:5127:details:1: BA deal I shall make with you, however... take this pike, it is imbued with powerful Fel energies. When you find ⟦E83⟧, slay him and drive this pike through his dying heart. His soul he bartered, his soul I shall have. Return the pike and return the breastplate that the thief stole and I shall teach you what it is that he was to learn.
rows.quest:5127:completion:0: Our pact you did not break. The soul I did take. The reward I shall make.
rows.quest:5160:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E76⟧ and find ⟦E88⟧. Give her ⟦E89⟧'s scale.
rows.quest:5160:details:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E73⟧, ⟦52⟧. Our flight makes its home in the frigid landscape of ⟦E76⟧. Once you reach ⟦E76⟧, find the caves of Mazthoril.
rows.quest:5160:details:1: Upon the icy floors of Mazthoril you will find cobalt runes. Hold one of my scales and stand upon a rune and you shall be transported to ⟦E88⟧, our matron protectorate.
rows.quest:5160:details:2: Give her the scale so that she may scry what it is I have seen and felt, here in this doomed place.
rows.quest:5160:progress:0: It is good to see you, ⟦53⟧.
rows.quest:5160:completion:0: The Aspects insist that we stay out of the affairs of mortals. In this world, however, such a thing is not always possible - especially when one of our own contemptuously disregards such edicts.
